text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to watch the Arima Kinen together 
with Smart Falcon. Nakayama Racecourse is 
filled with an extraordinary heat—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Coming through, please!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Eep!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah. We just bumped into each other a 
little, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that's an incredible crowd... Even 
moving around is a struggle.”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I think this every year, but the 'Arima 
Kinen' really is wildly popular, huh?
choice_data_list: It's a major year-end race, after all.
It's a major year-end race, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The year-end Grand Prix, the Arima Kinen. 
With so many Umamusume who made their mark 
that year participating, it attracts 
massive attention as the year's 
culminating race.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Up until last year, Falco only really 
felt the year ending at the Arima Kinen 
Winning Live, but..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The real, true end of the year is the 
Tokyo Daishoten~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's still one of the biggest races of the 
year, so I really hope everyone here comes 
to watch.
choice_data_list:
This year is sure to be even more exciting 
than last year.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: More than last year...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right on☆ The flyers are handing out 
nicely, so this year—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah! Look, everyone's coming out!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ooh. Those two have such a presence.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone else is staring straight ahead, 
too. This is gonna be an interesting race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—True to those words, this day's Arima 
Kinen became a race for the history books.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The race favorite Daiwa Scarlet takes the 
lead, setting the pace. And just like 
that, she brushes off the fiercely 
pursuing pack to--

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is number 13! Daiwa 
Scarleeeeeeet!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With overwhelming strength, she was 
crowned the Grand Prix Queen of that 
year...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Waaaah~~~~...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Scarlet-chan was so cool!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure she'll convey her fiery passion 
in the Winning Live as well—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right, the Winning Live! I have 
to get to the front row!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Let's dive in! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Winning Live I watched with Smart 
Falcon from the front row. That 
performance was overwhelming, and—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Thank you so much for your 
support today!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The "number one" Umamusume is none other 
than me♪ Daiwa Scarlet~!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAH! Daiwa Scarleeet~~!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haaah~~. Deep. Ly. Moved!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Scarlett-chan, you were shining so 
brightly out there.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“Not just that, but you could really feel 
her passion, screaming ‘Look at me!’...”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone in the audience was totally 
captivated by Scarlet-chan."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Girls competing at the top level really 
are amazing after all...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
With the way Falco and the others are now, 
they can definitely do it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just like the sparkling stage today, I'll 
hype up the Tokyo Daishoten too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“—I'm fine. Because dirt racing is so 
fun...”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco and the others did everything they 
could. They promoted it, gave it their all 
at the live...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So... it's gonna be okay.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It sounded a little like she was trying to 
convince herself, but in the next instant, 
Smart Falcon's eyes were sparkling with 
anticipation—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—The top of the dirt division is just 
within reach, huh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... the Classic-year Tokyo Daishoten 
is about to begin!
